theirReference: I stayed with Cristian in Bogotá for 3 days and it was a very interesting and authentic experience. Living in a local neighborhood (but close to city centre) with a Colombian family allowed me to really immerse myself in the culture and see the city from a non-touristic perspective. The hosts were very welcoming. Cristian showed me around the city, introduced me to local food, gave great recommendations on what to see and even let me use his public transport card, which was incredibly helpful. They have lovely pets at home - two cats and one dog. The animals are very friendly, curious and enjoy human contact. Just a small note: it’s important not to leave food unattended, even for a second 😄 I stepped away briefly and Pancho managed to eat my dinner. However, Cristian immediately made sure I wasn’t left hungry and shared the food they had at home. Overall, it was a warm and genuine Couchsurfing experience with true Colombian hospitality. Thank you for having me!
